form.label: Client → Hypervisor → App
form.description: Three columns — the user's Linux desktop, the Proxmox hypervisor, and the web-app — each with its own status, metrics, and detail.

search.query: index=london_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics host=desktop-* earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c latest(_time) as lt | eval up=if(c>0 AND (now()-lt)<900,1,0) | eval status=if(up=1,"● ONLINE · SENDING","○ OFFLINE"), range=if(up=1,"low","severe") | table status range
index=london_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics host=desktop-* | timechart span=1m avg(cpu_pct) as "CPU %" avg(mem_used_pct) as "Mem %"

index=london_linux sourcetype=linux:sessions host=desktop-* event=session status=logged_in | stats latest(_time) as last, latest(from) as from, latest(login_time) as login_time by user tty | eval last=strftime(last,"%F %T") | table user tty from login_time last | sort user

index=london_linux sourcetype=linux:ps host=desktop-* event=process | stats latest(pcpu) as "CPU %", latest(pmem) as "Mem %", latest(user) as user, latest(_time) as t by comm pid | where t >= relative_time(now(),"-3m") | sort - "CPU %" | head 10 | table comm pid user "CPU %" "Mem %"

index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c, count(eval(status=="error" OR status=="not_configured")) as errs | eval up=if(c>errs,1,0) | eval status=if(up=1,"● REACHABLE","○ NOT REACHABLE"), range=if(up=1,"low","severe") | table status range
index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=proxmox:metrics otype=node | timechart span=1m avg(cpu_pct) as "CPU %" avg(mem_used_pct) as "Mem %"

index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" (type=lxc OR type=qemu) | stats latest(status) as Status latest(type) as Type latest(vmid) as VMID by name | rename name as Name | table VMID Type Name Status | sort VMID

index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c latest(reachable) as r | eval up=if(c>0 AND r=1,1,0) | eval status=case(c=0,"○ UNKNOWN", r=1,"● AVAILABLE", true(),"○ NOT AVAILABLE"), range=if(up=1,"low","severe") | table status range
index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe | timechart span=1m latest(reachable) as reachable avg(latency_ms) as "latency (ms)"
index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe | head 1 | eval checked=strftime(_time,"%F %T"), state=if(reachable=1,"AVAILABLE","NOT AVAILABLE") | table checked state target http_status latency_ms

html.p: A user on the Linux desktop reaches the web-app running in an LXC container on the Proxmox hypervisor. The Hypervisor and App columns light up once Proxmox is reachable and create-webapp-container.sh has run. Only gary (global) sees all three; Leo sees the client, Ben the Berlin side.
